mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lostfound (type, title, description, category, images, location, reward, status, publisher_id) VALUES (#{type}, #{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{images}, #{location}, #{reward}, #{status}, #{publisherId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lostfound l LEFT JOIN user u ON l.publisher_id = u.user_id WHERE l.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE lostfound SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lostfound_claim (lostfound_id, claimer_id, message, status) VALUES (#{lostfoundId}, #{claimerId}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT lc.id, lc.lostfound_id, lc.claimer_id, lc.message, lc.status, lc.create_time FROM lostfound_claim lc WHERE lc.lostfound_id = #{lostfoundId} ORDER BY lc.create_time DESC
